sources.title: GitHub - HariMKL-oss/FinDocsAI
sources.snippet: FinDocs AI is a production-grade, open-source mock of an enterprise Regulatory Document Intelligence & Compliance Analytics platform. Designed and built to process complex banking procedures (BSA/AML, KYC), it showcases an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture prioritizing ultra-low latency, compliance monitoring, and cost observability.

sources.title: GitHub - shidokan/findocs · GitHub
sources.snippet: FinDocs AI Platform A multi-tenant Azure-based AI platform for retrieval-augmented financial document analysis. Built to demonstrate AI platform engineering at enterprise scale — not a single-tenant RAG application, but the infrastructure that hosts and governs AI workloads across multiple internal customers.
